name: doc-roadmap-narrative
description: Writes a Roadmap Narrative in prose, with Now, Next and Later items stated as problems, the strategy action behind each, confidence per horizon and what changed since last time and why. Use for "run doc-roadmap-narrative", "write our roadmap as a doc", "now next later roadmap", "roadmap without dates", "put a date on it and it becomes a promise", "every leader has a different version of the roadmap", "what changed on the roadmap", "explain the roadmap in writing", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
